svg.title: GREEK SQUAT · phone-net-ICKS
svg.desc: A stone colonnade in one-point perspective, after the Stoa at the UCLA Film and Television Archive. At the far end a small black cube with the Greek letter mu floats in the sky above the horizon. In the foreground an iPhone and an Android phone join at one USB-C plug, and points of light rise from it up the corridor into the cube.
